summary: Introduces become, which uses existing privilege escalation tools like sudo, su, pfexec, doas, pbrun, dzdo, ksu, runas and machinectl to run tasks as root or another user.
questions: How do I run Ansible tasks as root?
What privilege escalation tools does become support?

answer_card.title: What become is
answer_card.answer_md: `become` runs tasks with root or another user's permissions, different from the login (remote) user. It uses existing tools: `sudo`, `su`, `pfexec`, `doas`, `pbrun`, `dzdo`, `ksu`, `runas`, `machinectl`, and others.
